issues.detail: The Hebrew begins with 'לַמְנַצֵּחַ מַשְׂכִּיל לְדָוִד' (For the chief musician, a contemplation of David), which is entirely omitted in the Vietnamese. The Vietnamese adds 'Đức Chúa Trời ơi' (O God) as a vocative, which is not present in the Hebrew text (the Hebrew has no address to God in this verse).
